_barrier_taxonomy: 2026-07-29, owner interview: the channel's subject is ACCESS to the historical record, not territory/law. Four barriers block access — 'enclosure' (locked in university-press scholarship), 'language' (evidence not in English), 'ideology' (buried under an invented story), 'archive' (undigitised/unvisited). Which barrier carries breakout demand is an OPEN QUESTION the comment sweep exists to answer, so the set must span all four rather than optimise for one. The legacy 'category' field (style-match/broad-history/geopolitics) is retained for existing consumers; 'barrier' is the new axis.
